route: scripted (procedural Blender geometry, rig and keyed clips; no provider generation)

skin.policy: rigid: one bone per vertex at weight 1.0

rootMotion: code-owned: the root joint is never animated and every clip plays in place

gaps: The posture is still upright: the forearms now hang 12 degrees forward, but the sheet hunches the torso and drives the fists ahead of the knees. The spine hunch was not built (a pelvis pitch drops the belt front into the planted thigh plate in frozen).

The upper-body brass is darker than the sheet's in the engine (shoulder plates V 0.43 to 0.46 and head V 0.44 against about 0.60) while the forearm matches (V 0.49 to 0.52). Brass is one slot with one tint, so lifting it means raising the manifest tint together with the asset-check materials record.
The walnut has plank joints and five shades but no fine wood grain (that needs a baked texture with real UVs); the pleats are close in hue (20 against 15) but less saturated (S 0.41 against 0.47).
From the side the upper arm leaves through the centre of the shoulder plate's lens, so the dark lens reads as a ring round the arm rather than a full disc.
The curled finger tips read slightly pointed where each sweep turns under the mass.
The feet are layered blocks and the pelvis is a plain gunmetal bulge.

Through the death fall the thigh plates pass under the belt band while the body folds (about 30 crossing triangles per side), and for about 0.1 s mid-fall (frames 34 to 37) the inner rim of each shoulder plate crosses the back of the chimney base (20 to 23 triangles outside the barrel, up to 1.3 cm deep).
The grille glow hue (41 against the sheet's 33), its orange-red rim and spill, and the hit flare belong to the shared runtime glow, pending an owner decision.
In the EEVEE compare renders the grilles read pale because the D11 glow ramp is runtime-only; the engine shots show the intended amber core.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium on ANGLE Metal, Apple M4, with the runtime D11 glow look; glow-close is the seat camera narrowed to the upper body). This pass followed the independent review (77/100) and its top fixes: the drum pauldrons are replaced by one tall shoulder plate per side (front: x 0.47 to 0.72, z 1.18 to 1.82, a sloped top and rounded outer corner; side: a rim ring, a mid ring and a bezel round a dark glass lens; still a surface of revolution about the shoulder axis, so it turns in place through the attack raise) with a front-outer emerald; each fist is a rounded mitt (p 3 loft, 0.53 m wide) with four round curled finger sweeps whose fronts face the room and a rounded thumb folded across them; the barrel is an egg (widest 0.60 at z 1.47 to 1.52, 0.556 at the bottom band) over rounder pleats; the forearms hang 12 degrees forward; each walnut stave is five planks with 8 mm joints onto the dark interior in five hashed shades (case roughness 0.92); the face plate stands 1.6 cm proud with round 16-segment eyes; the elbow emeralds sit on the forearm cuffs' front-outer face. A green blob count (hue 100 to 170, S > 0.4, at least 4 px) on the front compare panel finds 6 emeralds (2 shoulder, 2 elbow, 2 knee). Engine colour medians (idle shot unless noted): forearm brass (133, 100, 58) and (124, 91, 49), V 0.52 and 0.49; head (111, 79, 38), V 0.44; shoulder plates (117, 87, 45) and (110, 81, 43) in glow-close, V 0.46 and 0.43 (concept about V 0.61); finger fronts V 0.53 on the upper fronts and 0.36 on the lower curl (the pass-3 plate fronts measured 0.28 in the same box); barrel walnut (69, 50, 32), V 0.27 under the walnut mask and (52, 37, 30), V 0.20 on the stave field right of the grille in glow-close (concept about V 0.22); pleats between the straps (51, 37, 30), hue 20, S 0.41, V 0.20 (concept hue 15, S 0.47, V 0.17); front grille glow (245, 192, 80); eyes (243, 178, 71). Fine high-pass std (gray minus a 3 px blur) on the stave field rose from 1.41 to 2.20 (right of the grille) and from 6.03 to 8.78 (above the grille) against pass 3 in the same boxes. Vent: the chimney flame plume on the sheet is not modeled. p5-automatons-design.md models the vent as an emissive chimney mouth only and the art bible rules out smoke, so each mouth carries a glowing ember dome instead; this is a design-note deviation, not a fidelity gap.

rubric.note: Up 1 from pass 2. Two shapes moved toward the sheet. The fists are now closed brass masses wider than the gauntlet. On the orthographic front compare panel, a non-background row-span scan (more than 30 summed RGB from the backdrop (48, 44, 41)) gives the model's left arm 50-58 px across the gauntlet (y 508-556) and 65 px across the fist (y 580-596), a ratio of about 1.14, and the right arm 52-58 px against 59-65 px. On the concept, the fist's outer edge sits about 8 px outside the gauntlet's outer edge (x 17 at y 596 against x 25 at y 548). The concept's inner edge merges with the legs, so no clean ratio exists there. Pass 2 had an open cupped hand narrower than the gauntlet. The legs now carry brass thigh plates, round knee caps and layered brass shins (frozen crop x 280-640, y 440-720 at 2x; front compare panel), replacing the slim black cylinders. Unchanged and still off: the pauldrons are side-on stacked drums with a dome cap (front and back compare panels, glow-close x 720-900), where the sheet draws tall curved plates hugging the barrel; the barrel has near-straight sides in the front panel against the sheet's egg; the side panel stands upright with the forearm hanging under the shoulder, where the sheet hunches and drives the fist ahead of the knee; the fists are square plated boxes, not the sheet's rounded mitt; and the feet are flat slabs.

Up 1 from pass 2. Kept: the front grille has six glow slots between five bars, counted as six glow runs on rows y 400, 420 and 440 of glow-close (mask R>235, G>150, B<110); the faceted head with two round amber eyes; the arched back strap; ember domes in place of the flame plume per the design note. New: knee emeralds now read from the front, clean round gems in a brass bezel (hit crop x 330-620, y 520-650 at 2x), A green connected-blob count (hue 100-170, S>0.4, at least 4 px) finds 3 gems on the model front compare panel (one pauldron rim and two knees) against 4 on the concept front panel. The concept's smaller elbow and knee gems partly fall under the 4 px threshold at that scale, and about 6 are visible by eye on the sheet (an estimate). No elbow or upper-arm gem faces the front on the model. The fist now has a knuckle row and a thumb plate folded across the fingers instead of the pass-2 pegs and tube thumb. Still short: the fist fingers are flat rectangular plates with dark fronts that read as slots in a box, not curled fingers; and the side pauldron is a plain brass dome with an emerald, not the sheet's ring with a dark lens.

Up 1 from pass 2. The pass-3 brass claim holds: at glow-close the head face and pauldron show smooth gradients with no grain or swirl (zoom of x 340-510, y 20-230 at 3x and x 720-900, y 240-560 at 2x); fine high-pass std (gray minus 1.5 px blur) is 2.46 inside the head face plate (box 395-450, 60-95) and 2.34 on the pauldron. The finger-plate fronts no longer read as wood grain, though they stay dark: idle left finger fronts median (79, 52, 17), V 0.31, against the fist body (117, 84, 46), V 0.46, and forearm (138, 102, 59), V 0.54. The plates stand proud with bevelled rims and no visible z-fighting or thumb gap at 3x. The fist and thumb shading is visibly faceted. Still flat: the walnut has a fine high-pass std of 2.89 at blur 3 in glow-close against 9.56 on the sheet's barrel, with no plank grain or horizontal plank joints. The face plate is a thin outline barely raised from the head, and the eyes are about 10-sided polygons at glow-close. The pelvis is plain.

Unchanged at 12. Brass now matches on the forearm and head: idle forearm (138, 102, 59), hue 33, S 0.57, V 0.54, against the sheet's (144, 100, 53), hue 31, S 0.63, V 0.56; idle head (135, 93, 46) against (133, 96, 53). The pauldron is still dark: glow-close (115, 86, 44), V 0.45, against the sheet's (155, 115, 65), V 0.61. The walnut is lighter than the sheet: idle (76, 48, 34), V 0.30, against (56, 36, 25), V 0.22, same hue (20 against 21). The pleats are greyer and yellower: (53, 42, 32), hue 29, S 0.40, V 0.21, against (43, 28, 23), hue 15, S 0.47, V 0.17. The grille core is still yellower: idle glow median (247, 195, 75), hue 42, against the sheet's (232, 153, 56), hue 33, with no orange-red rim or spill onto the walnut.

Up 1 from pass 2. At 2.6 m the fists, the nearest and largest shapes, now read as closed crushing fists in idle, hit, attack and frozen. Pass 2 read them as cupped pegs or pale teeth, so this helps the crush tell. The head, eyes and six-slot grille remain a strong focal point. Against that, the fists read as square boxes with four dark slots. The hit shot still has no core flare: hit glow (246, 192, 75) against idle (247, 195, 75), so the hit tell relies on pose alone. The frozen tint gap is a known evidence gap and is not counted.

topFixes: Replace the drum-stack pauldrons with tall curved brass shoulder plates that hug the upper barrel and cap the shoulder, as on the sheet front and back. Carry the side ring with a dark lens and set an emerald facing forward. Then lift the pauldron brass from V 0.45 to about 0.60 in the engine. This is the largest silhouette miss left in every front, back and seated view.

Round the fist into the sheet's mitt. Chamfer or bevel the box corners, turn the four flat finger plates into curled knuckle segments with rounded fronts, and lift the finger-front value from V 0.31 to about 0.40-0.45 so they stop reading as dark slots. Use smooth normals on the fist and thumb so the faceting disappears.
Give the barrel the sheet's egg profile, widest at the chest and tapering into the pleats, and add a forward hunch with forearms angled so the fists sit ahead of the knees in idle and side views.
Add plank grain and horizontal plank joints to the walnut, through a baked or tileable normal and albedo variation, and darken it from V 0.30 to about 0.22. Shift the pleats toward hue 15 at S 0.47.
Shift the grille glow from hue 42 to about 33 with an orange-red rim and a spill onto the surrounding walnut, and add a brief core flare to the hit clip.
Raise the head face plate into a distinct proud plate, and raise the eye discs to 16 or more segments so they read round at glow-close.
independentScore.method: Independent pass-3 review by an agent that did not build the model. The author's header text and self-score on the compare and review sheets were ignored. Only provenance.json independentScore (pass 2, 73) was read, for deltas. Silhouette was judged from the EEVEE orthographic front, side and back panels of bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg, cropped and enlarged 2x with Pillow beside the concept panels. Material, colour and readability were weighted on the six three.js engine shots (seated player at 2.6 m, runtime glow), with targeted 2-3x Lanczos crops of the fists (idle), legs and belt (frozen), knees (hit), and the head and pauldron (glow-close). Colours are medians over hand-placed boxes with hue, saturation and value masks (walnut hue 5-32, brass hue 22-50 at V>0.35, pleats V<0.30, glow max>180), compared with matching boxes on golem-sheet-1.png. Texture grain is a high-pass standard deviation (grayscale minus a Gaussian blur at 1.5 px and 3 px). Grille slots are glow runs along three rows in glow-close. Emeralds are green connected blobs (hue 100-170, S>0.4) in the compare panels. Results on the pass-3 claims: brass grain and head swirl gone, confirmed; fist plates stand proud with no visible overlap fighting or thumb gap, confirmed at 3x, though the finger fronts stay dark and the shading faceted; legs do not cut into the belt in the frozen pose, confirmed (in the engine frozen shot the right fist hides the right leg, so the left leg was checked there and both legs in staging/renders/anim-frozen.png at 5x, where each thigh plate sits below the belt band without crossing it); knee emeralds clean, confirmed. The rubric weights are 30, 25, 20, 15 and 10, the bar is 80, and the points sum to the score.
